def workflow(folder_name: str):
    # Create the contact in Salesforce
    contact = Salesforce_Contact__5_0_0__create_Contact()

    # Create the Box folder for the contact
    Box_Folder__3_0_0__create_Folder(contact['Name'] + "'s Folder" if folder_name is None else folder_name)

    # If the folder name is None, send an email using Outlook
    if folder_name is None:
        Microsoft_Exchange_Messages__2_0_0__SENDOUTLOOK_Messages(contact['Email'], "New Folder Created!",
                                                                    f"Hello {contact['Name']},\n\nA new Box folder has been created for you.\n\nBest,\nThe Box Team")
